g.text: Ordering A — deduct the ledger first
Ordering B — release the hold first
The bug is the boundary, not the sequence.

text.tspan: UNDERSELL: the ledger is deducted but the Redis hold
is never released, so those units stay invisible until
the TTL expires — or forever, if there is no TTL.
OVERSELL: the hold is gone so another buyer can take
the same unit, but the ledger was never decremented.
